concepts.reader_question: Which stage is each outsourced lot at?
concepts.description: A Fabless operations review of separate partner reports and a semiconductor wafer in a protective carrier; integrate restrained open relationship paths to express the unanswered lot-stage question without marking anything confirmed. All background records blank; no microglyphs, data, ticks, seals, identifiers, dates, results or added labels. Official mark once; print only exact approved artwork text. Semiconductor scene and diagrams share material depth, lighting and shadows.
